new_value: Zero rank DIOs are already rejected by the existing check at line 128 in candidate_admissible: `if candidate.rank < min_hop_rank_increase`. With MIN_HOP_RANK_INCREASE=256, rank=0 fails this check (0 < 256 = true). This check runs for both same-version DIOs (line 434) and newer-version DIOs (line 393). Existing tests (lines 1234, 1244) verify this pattern works for ranks below root (100 and 255). No additional explicit rank=0 check is needed.
